result.topic_en: This is the title and opening paragraph of Riemann's essay on fractional differentiation and integration. It announces a procedure that derives from a given function a new function, dependent on a number, which reduces to derivatives, integrals or the original function when that number is a positive, negative or zero integer.

items.english: In the following essay an attempt is made to set up a procedure by means of which one can derive, from a given function of one variable, another function of the same variable. Its dependence on the original function can be expressed by a number. In the case where this number is a positive integer, a negative integer or zero, the derived function coincides respectively with the differential quotients, the integrals, and the original function.
